goal: Validate practical SIEM deployment options for CyberOps Sandbox, establish the available hosting resources and constraints, select a feasible Wazuh deployment approach, prepare the Week 2 implementation starting point.
definition_of_done: Confirm usable host disk capacity and current memory constraints, identify existing VMware VM resource allocations and relevant network connectivity, select a practical SIEM hosting approach, document unresolved dependencies and the first implementation milestone.
dependencies: Physical host resource availability, existing VMware VM workloads, Linux VM availability or deployment alternatives, network connectivity between the SIEM and Windows endpoint, compatibility with the existing lab.
tech_context: Physical Windows host, VMware Workstation, OPNsense 26.7, WIN11-CLIENT01 at 192.168.20.165, NS-DC01 running Windows Server 2025 with AD DS and DNS, LAN subnet 192.168.20.0/24, SERVERS subnet 192.168.10.0/24, proposed Wazuh SIEM deployment, Windows Security and PowerShell Operational event logs enabled.
